gst.note: GST registration mandatory when annual turnover exceeds 20 lakh INR
gst.exportOfService: Zero-rated under IGST for payments from foreign brands
gst.filingFrequency: Quarterly for turnover under 5 crore, monthly otherwise
gst.inputTaxCredit: Claim ITC on GST paid for equipment, software, and services used in content creation
gst.reverseCharge: GST on import of services (e.g., paying foreign SaaS tools) applies under reverse charge mechanism

rebate87A.note: Full tax rebate if total income does not exceed 7 lakh under new regime

section44ADA.applicableTo: Professionals with gross receipts under 75 lakh
section44ADA.rate: 50% of gross receipts deemed as profit
section44ADA.note: No need to maintain books of accounts; content creators often qualify as professionals

brandDeals.note: Indian brands deduct TDS; claim credit when filing ITR. 194R applies when total benefit/perquisite exceeds 20,000 per year from one payer.

adSense.note: No TDS on AdSense income from Google (foreign remittance). Declare under income from other sources or business income.

affiliateIncome.note: TDS deducted by brands paying commission/affiliate income above 15,000 per year

courseSales_domesticPlatform.note: If course platform (Indian) deducts TDS on revenue share, it will be under 194C or 194J. Claim credit in ITR.

courseSales_foreignPlatform.note: Platforms like Udemy, Teachable (foreign) do not deduct Indian TDS. Declare full income and pay advance tax.

rentals.note: TDS on studio/office rent if annual rent exceeds 2.4 lakh

professionalServices.note: TDS on payments to contractors (editors, designers, voice artists) if payment exceeds 30,000 per year

foreignRemittances.note: Income from YouTube AdSense, foreign brand deals, Patreon, etc. is exempt from TDS but must be declared. FEMA compliance required for large inflows.

lateITRFiling.note: Penalty for filing ITR after due date (July 31 for non-audit cases)

defaultInAdvanceTax.note: Applies if advance tax paid is less than 90% of assessed tax

defermentOfAdvanceTax.rate: 1% per month on shortfall per installment
defermentOfAdvanceTax.note: Applies if each installment is short of required cumulative percentage

nonDeductionOfTDS.consequence: Assessee treated as 'assessee in default'; interest at 1.5% per month + potential prosecution

concealmentOfIncome.penalty: 100% to 300% of tax on concealed income

nonFilingGST.lateFee: Rs 50 per day (Rs 20 for nil returns) subject to maximum of Rs 10,000 per return

allowableBusinessExpenses: Internet and mobile bills (proportionate to business use)
Editing software subscriptions (Adobe, DaVinci, CapCut Pro)
Studio rent or home office proportion
Contractor payments (editors, thumbnail designers, video managers)
AI tool subscriptions (ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, Midjourney)
Co-working space memberships used for content work

businessStructures.pros: Simple, no compliance overhead, minimal registration
businessStructures.cons: Unlimited personal liability, limited credibility with large brands
businessStructures.bankAccount: Current account in own name or trade name

businessStructures.pros: Limited liability, single owner, better brand credibility
businessStructures.cons: More compliance than sole prop, MCA annual filings required

businessStructures.bestFor: Two or more co-founders, 20 lakh to 2 crore
businessStructures.pros: Limited liability, flexible profit sharing, lower compliance than Pvt Ltd

businessStructures.bestFor: Above 50 lakh or planning to raise investment/hire
businessStructures.pros: Best for investment, ESOP for team, most credible with enterprise brands, GST ITC optimization
businessStructures.cons: Higher compliance cost, statutory audit mandatory above 2 crore turnover
